name: api-migrator
description: API Migration Campaigns as a Service — find affected customer code, deliver tested, reviewable migration pull requests.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:console
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @api-migrator/engine && npm run build --workspace @api-migrator/db && npm run build --workspace @api-migrator/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.ci: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm run test:workspaces && npm run build:console
